description: This file contains functions related to CSRF (Cross-Site Request Forgery) security, including token generation, validation, session management, and form replacement to add CSRF tokens for security. It includes functions for session handling, token validation, and form modification to embed CSRF protection in HTML forms.

methods.name: store_in_session
methods.description: Stores a key/value pair in the session, returning true if successful.

methods.name: unset_session
methods.description: Removes a key from the session, returning true if successful.

methods.name: get_from_session
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the session by key, or false if not found.

methods.name: csrfguard_generate_token
methods.description: Generates a CSRF token for a unique form name and stores it in the session.

methods.name: csrfguard_validate_token
methods.description: Validates a CSRF token against the stored session token.

methods.name: csrfguard_replace_forms
methods.description: Replaces HTML form tags to include CSRF hidden input fields, adding security tokens.

methods.name: smarty_csrf_filter
methods.description: Filters Smarty template content to include CSRF protections in forms.

methods.name: csrfguard_start
methods.description: Validates CSRF tokens received via POST and redirects if validation fails.
